membership_basis: Independent dual review, governed two-stage adjudication, explicit derived MULTI_REVIEWER_ADJUDICATED promotion, and canonical Phase 3H.5 qualification.
governance_workflow: Two independent reviewers, disagreement analysis, two-stage adjudication, explicit quality-tier promotion, and separate canonical Gold Set inclusion audit.
supportable_claims: DriftWatch constructed a governed four-case Gold Set from browser-extension version transitions that completed independent review, two-stage adjudication, and explicit quality-tier promotion.
All four Gold Set records are adjudicated risky transitions with MULTI_REVIEWER_ADJUDICATED quality and zero external-holdout overlap.
limitations: The Gold Set contains only four scoped cases.
All current labels are risky_transition, so the set cannot estimate class-balanced performance.
The distribution is not representative of the browser-extension population.
Gold Set membership is not malware ground truth or training authorization.
